message.content:
Steel balls for bearings are classified in heading 7326 (other articles of iron or steel) or 8482 (ball bearings, including steel balls). Heading 8482.91 covers parts of ball or roller bearings: balls, needles, and rollers. 8482.91.00 is "Balls, needles and rollers", and the 10-digit codes are 8482.91.0010 (Balls, steel, of a kind used in bearings...) and 8482.91.0090 (other).

Checking the statistical suffixes: 8482.91.00 has 10 "Balls" and 20 "Rollers", etc. In the HTSUS: 8482.91.00 Balls, needles and rollers: 8482.91.0010 Balls; 8482.91.0020 Tapered rollers; 8482.91.0030 Other rollers; 8482.91.0040 Needles... The ball 10 g weight (about 13 mm diameter) is a steel ball. Note 8482.80 is for other bearings, including combined ball/roller. Heading 8482 also has 8482.10 for ball bearings. The balls themselves go to 8482.91.0010 ("Balls"). I'm fairly confident that the AD/CVD case for steel balls (China, India, Korea) lists 8482.40.00, 8482.91.00, 8482.99.35, and 8483.90.30, and 7326.11.00, 7326.19.00 as well. With a 10.02 g polished ball, 8482.91.0010 applies.
